Similar to --defeat-rst-ratelimit, the --defeat-icmp-ratelimit option trades accuracy for speed, increasing UDP scanning speed against hosts that rate-limit ICMP error messages.
Many hosts have long used rate limiting to reduce the number of ICMP error messages (such as port-unreachable errors) they send.
